title: Battle of Kay
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Kay", at revision 1370444978, opens: "The Battle of Kay, also referred to as the Battle of Sulechów, Battle of Züllichau, or Battle of Paltzig, was an engagement fought on 23 July 1759 during the Seven Years' War. It occurred near Kay (Kije) in the Neumark, now part of Poland." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q473706, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1759 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
